description: Karnataka has approved a ₹1,300.45 crore data centre policy aimed at strengthening the infrastructure needed to run artificial intelligence, cloud computing
body_lead: Karnataka has approved a ₹1,300.45 crore data centre policy aimed at strengthening the infrastructure needed to run artificial intelligence, cloud computing and other high-demand digital services. The state cabinet cleared the Sustainable Data Centre Policy 2026–2031 on Friday. Karnataka is targeting 1 gigawatt of cumulative data centre IT load and wants to account for 10–12% of India’s AI-ready data centre capacity by 2031. The cabinet also approved a separate ₹120 crore Marine Biotechnology Policy, creating a five-year roadmap to expand Karnataka’s so-called blue bioeconomy.
